svg.title: Motion profile: slide the setpoint, don't jump it
svg.desc: Animated graph of position over time, drawn left to right. A gray dashed step setpoint jumps from start to target all at once: be there now, which is impossible. A blue dashed profile setpoint instead slides smoothly from start to target along an S: it speeds up, cruises, then slows down. On the right, two markers on rails show the same two setpoints moving: the step marker jumps to the target in an instant, the profile marker glides there. A profile asks for something the mechanism can actually do, so feedback only has to follow: it can be stiffer without overshoot, and current spikes vanish. Do it after feedforward and PID work.
svg.text: Motion profile: slide the setpoint, don't jump it
Instead of jumping the setpoint, move it smoothly along a planned path.
A step asks for the impossible: be there now. A profile asks for something
the mechanism can actually do: speed up at a set rate, cruise, slow down.
Feedback then only has to follow, so it can be stiffer without overshoot,
Do it after feedforward and PID work: on a badly tuned loop it hides the problem.
